consumer: The dialogue/condition evaluator built by set_has_item (u_has_item/npc_has_item), which asks the yes/no question: does the character actor possess at least one c4?
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person possession, the actor's charges_of/has_amount reach)
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item — its body returns the engine-computed boolean actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1), the possession predicate a dialogue/mission condition consumes
divergence: A c4 brick lying on the ground at the avatar's feet (or in an adjacent vehicle/container), not carried: the engine's u_has_item returns false, but a backend that re-derives possession over nearby/reachable items would wrongly return true
